item.title: Youth Business International (YBI)
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Youth Business International (YBI)
https://www.youthbusiness.org/

Entrepreneurship is a transformative option to unlock income generation. Youth entrepreneurship creates decent work for young people, strengthens communities and drives inclusive economic growth, but for too many young people, entrepreneurship is out of reach.

YBI supports young people (18-35) around the world to start, grow and sustain businesses.

Together with our members, we equip disadvantaged young people to build the skills, confidence and connections they need to beat the odds and become successful business owners.

item.title: EU-Startups.com
item.author: emecas
item.description:
EU-Startups.com
https://www.eu-startups.com/

EU-Startups.com is the leading online publication with a focus on startups in Europe. The website was founded in October of 2010.

We write about internet and tech startups out of Europe and provide our readers with data-driven analysis, interviews and startup-related news. In addition to our focus on young technology companies, we also publish other kinds of news out of the tech-space that has a commercial or cultural impact on startups in Europe.

item.title: Hyperledger
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Hyperledger
https://www.hyperledger.org/
Hyperledger is an open source collaborative effort created to advance cross-industry blockchain technologies. It is a global collaboration, hosted by The Linux Foundation, including leaders in finance, banking, IoT, supply chain, manufacturing and technology.

Projects: Business Blockchain Frameworks Hosted with Hyperledger

Hyperledger Burrow
Hyperledger Burrow provides a modular blockchain client with a permissioned smart contract interpreter partially developed to the specification of the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM).
